Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate Granola
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Sunday, November 18, 2012 - 9:07pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup sugar
1/4 cup maple syrup
1/4 cup honey
2 tbsps peanut butter
1 whole egg whites
1 tsp evaporated milk
1 tsp vanilla
1 cup whole wheat flour
1/2 tsp soda
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp allspice
2 cups oats
1 1/2 cups rice cereal
1/3 cup dark chocolate (Xocai Healthy Chocolate X Power Squares, chopped)
1/4 cup nuts (chopped)
2 tsps flax seeds ((optional))

Preparation

1 Combine the first 7 ingredients, then the next 4 in a separate bowl; add this to the first mixture. Add the last ingredients one at a time. Place in a 9x13 inch greased dish, press down and bake at 350 degrees for 18-20 minutes. Serves 12
